title: TLS certificate and hostname boundaries
summary: TLS handshakes depend on certificate trust, hostname selection and configured protocol support. Separate client-facing TLS from upstream TLS when locating a failed route.
checks: Run allowlisted TLS and route checks with the intended hostname.
limitations: Client-facing success does not establish upstream TLS correctness.
applicability: Nginx SSL module; deployment-specific trust and build
